name: Support bot error reviewer
why: Marks a bot's answers against approved help text and turns failures into retest cases, the same loop as the chatbot test and review skill.

name: Agent injection evidence review assistant
why: Safe prompt injection test cases and a control gap list, run only with the owner's written approval, matching this role's injection rules.

name: Monthly help centre keeper
why: Finds questions the help pages miss each month, which keeps the bot's knowledge base current.

name: Help article writer from support tickets
why: Turns solved tickets into short articles in customers' words, ready to become bot knowledge entries.

name: FAQ page writer from customer questions
why: Builds a question-and-answer page from real customer questions, a good source document for a support bot.

name: Clear your support inbox and turn fixes into help pages
why: Sorts open tickets and writes help pages from the fixes, the groundwork before a bot is launched.

name: Check an AI app improvement
why: Sets evaluation criteria before and after a change, the habit of retesting after every instruction or knowledge change.

name: Harden an AI app against hijacked prompts and runaway bills
why: Defences and tests against hidden instructions and spending spikes for a bot built in code.

name: Workflow diagram and change planner
why: Draws a process as a diagram and checks each hand-off, useful for mapping bot-to-person hand-overs.

name: Customer question keyword finder
why: Pulls the questions customers really ask from reviews and tickets, the starting list for bot intents.

name: Answer-first page rewriter
why: Rewrites pages answer first and flags facts without a source, the same shape as a good knowledge entry.
